verified_facts: The visually checked rotation passage reports 318.1 degrees true, not 318.18. PDF text extraction confuses the degree symbol with a digit.
Positive along-stream flow points northwest; positive cross-stream flow points offshore toward the southwest in Figure 3.
The study uses harmonic detiding. A separate 36-hour Butterworth comparison checks tidal removal; it does not make filtered and detided products identical.
ADCP bin depths use corrected MicroCAT depths. Surface-interference editing removes the upper six percent of instrument-to-surface distance.
The study subsamples instruments hourly. Its analysis processing cannot be assumed identical to the deposited half-hourly point-meter records.
Figure 2 shows instrument displacement during blowdown. Section gridding retains a changing upper sampling boundary instead of filling unsampled surface layers.
